## Checks

Control take: AUC (%) of the control take (normal, after a remount) against the same-mount normals; about 50 means the model does not hear the remount. Drift: AUC (%) of the later half of the same-mount normals against the earlier half; about 50 means no drift over the take. CNN only: training accuracy at the last epoch (%, counted on mixup-blended inputs) and the share (%) of normalised inputs outside the training range, which the int8 input would clip.
